# Overview of Session 3 {#sec-s3}

::: {.callout-important appearance="simple"}
## Coming soon
This session's chapters are being written. The plan is below.
:::

**Theme:** Functions, input, rule, output. Cost, revenue and profit functions; demand; sales growth.

**Planned chapters:** what a function is (table, graph, formula); linear functions, slope and intercept; power and quadratic functions; exponential growth and logarithms; your business: cost, revenue and profit functions; practice; catch-up sheet.

**Further reading (optional):** @maybart2025, sec. 1.1–1.2, pp. 1–12, and sec. 2.2, pp. 67–76; @stitz2013, sec. 6.1, pp. 417–436; also @stitz2013, sec. 1.3–1.4, pp. 43–75, and sec. 2.1, pp. 151–172 and @porto2022, ch. 3, pp. 243–258 and 300–330. In German: @gundlach2024, ch. 2–3, pp. 25–48.
